entries.test: Corporate filings and contemporaneous leadership records would establish corporate identity and Jesse Lyu’s CEO roles as of publication.
entries.note: The source says Lyu was and is GAMA’s CEO; the proposition shifts that assertion to the corporate entity behind Rabbit.

entries.test: Contemporaneous pricing, shipping records, and published launch reviews would establish whether the $200 R1 was shipping and generally received unfavorable reviews.
entries.note: The review claim has a plain reading about published reception.

entries.test: Corporate records, funding announcements, product sales, and archived GAMA communications would establish the entity’s transition and the interval after it stopped engaging with users.
entries.note: The proposition omits the explicit timing claim that the transition occurred mere months after disappearing on users.
“Highly suggests” presents a tentative legal inference rather than a firm assertion of legal incapacity.

entries.test: Funding announcements, company communications, and GAMA’s operational status at publication would establish the mission change and evidence of abandonment of the mission funded with $6 million.
entries.note: The proposition preserves “appears” and extracts the factual assertion embedded in the recommendation to inform buyers.
This is a demand for a comprehensive, honest explanation.
The source alleges attempted gaslighting; “people he misled” asserts that the attempt succeeded. The central claim calls for an apology.

entries.test: Archived company disclosures and contemporary R1 setup documentation or demonstrations would establish what Rabbit disclosed and whether connecting services required entering credentials through a remote virtual machine.
entries.note: The surrounding article supplies concrete disclosure omissions, while the credential requirement is directly testable.

entries.test: Launch documentation and contemporaneous independent device tests would establish whether Teach Mode was absent and the advertised Large Action Model operated reliably at launch.
entries.note: This concerns launch functionality, regardless of later updates.
The proposition broadens “reporters he has talked to” to reporters generally and turns efforts to obfuscate into accomplished concealment. The central assertion is an obligation to explain.
